claims: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints will update to a new two-hour Sunday schedule starting September 6, 2026.
The new schedule includes a 60-minute sacrament meeting.
The new schedule includes a 5-minute break.
The new schedule includes 25-minute classes for Sunday School, Relief Society, Priesthood, and Young Women every week rather than alternating.
Sacrament Meeting is from 0:00 to 1:00 (60 minutes) for all attendees.
Sunday School is from 1:05 to 1:30 (25 minutes) for adults and youth.
Relief Society, Priesthood, and Young Women classes are from 1:35 to 2:00 (25 minutes).
Primary for children under 12 lasts 55 minutes during the second hour concurrently.
Sunday School lessons focus on scripture study using "Come, Follow Me — For Home and Church".
5th Sundays are dedicated to further instruction or as directed by the bishop.
Specific ward times (start times) are determined by local leaders to accommodate multiple congregations in one building.
